name: Nyrna
description: Adds a Suspend command to Moonlight's in-stream menu, which suspends the game or application in the foreground using Nyrna. While it's suspended, a notification on this PC shows it with a Resume button, and the command becomes Resume. If Nyrna is already running on this PC, the command presses its hotkey. Games with anti-cheat usually can't be suspended.
author: Sunshine

options.label: Nyrna's hotkey
options.description: The hotkey set in Nyrna, such as Pause or Ctrl+Alt+P. When Nyrna is already running (for example installed, with its tray icon), the command presses this hotkey instead, since a second Nyrna can't run alongside it.

options.label: Allow minimizing
options.description: Turn this off to leave the frozen window on screen while it's suspended. When it's on, Nyrna's own setting decides whether the window is minimized.

options.label: Resume command label
options.description: The command's label in Moonlight's menu while something is suspended. %APP% becomes the name of what's suspended.
